---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for the Agent Skills repository
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing. What workflow is difficult or impossible today?

Ex: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the ideal outcome and how it would integrate with the existing Agent Skills™ ecosystem.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered. Explain why the proposed solution is preferable.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, code samples, or references that help illustrate the feature request.
